findings.claim: docs/workflows.md's railroad-review section still documents lane/refuter/station branches as `claude/railroad-{direction}-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6}`, `claude/railroad-refute-{finding-id}-r{round}-{hash6}`, `claude/railroad-station-r{round}-{hash6}`, and the cleanup line as `claude/railroad-*`, while spec-7's correctness-55 requires every railroad-review branch (lane, refuter, station) to move to the `claude-review/*` namespace with prose updated to match — this prose was not updated.
findings.fix: Update docs/workflows.md's railroad-review section to the claude-review/* branch patterns (e.g. claude-review/{direction}-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6}, claude-review/refute-{finding-id}-r{round}-{hash6}, claude-review/station-r{round}-{hash6}) and the cleanup line's glob, matching the actual implementation.
findings.evidence: Re-read docs/workflows.md lines 60-66 (committed e5245d08) in full: every branch pattern named in the railroad-review section still uses the retired claude/railroad-* prefix. Confirmed this section is untouched by the reviewed diff (git diff b4981b8...e5245d0 -- docs/workflows.md shows no hunk touching these lines) — the required rename (spec-7 correctness-55) landed in code/behavior (observed live: this review's own lane branch is named claude-review/rr-...) but the doc was never updated to match, which is exactly what correctness-55 requires ('cleanup and prose updated to match'). Claim survives re-check.

findings.claim: ACDSL-JSON-002's anchor `^sessions/(personal|work)/json/.*\.json$` still gates batch summary JSON only under the retired `sessions/personal/` and `sessions/work/` scope folders; this diff retires the --scopes work/personal concept and partitions session output per connected repo (`sessions/<repo>/json/*.json`, plus `default/`/`archived/`) per correctness-63, so every batch JSON written from now on lands outside the anchor. Because the rule carries `empty="ok"`, the anchor matching zero files is tolerated silently instead of tripping ACDSL's no-match typo guard — the schema gate silently stops covering any new batch JSON.
findings.fix: Update ACDSL-JSON-002's anchor to match the new per-repo session folders, e.g. anchor="^sessions/(?!archived/)[^/]+/json/.*\.json$" (or equivalent excluding proposals/), so the schema gate keeps covering batch JSON under the new layout.
findings.evidence: Re-read the full diff of acdsl/rules.acdsl (only ACDSL-JSON-003 was added; ACDSL-JSON-002's anchor line is untouched) and README.md's diff, which confirms the session layout change ('one folder per connected repo ... sessions/<repo>/json/') is part of this same change. Cross-checked acdsl-spec.md §6.1: an anchor resolving to zero files is normally the typo-guard violation, but empty="ok" (set on this rule) suppresses that signal, so the gate will pass green while checking nothing, for every repo going forward. Claim survives re-check.

notes: Cross-chunk suspicion (spec-7 correctness-54): cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh (my chunk) is the mechanism that requires railroad-review lanes to invoke Skill() bare and receive full-doctrine injection — the opposite of spec-7's --no-context opt-out requirement. The known ledger already carries this as correctness-BLK-6-r1 against skills/quality/railroad-review/SKILL.md (a different chunk), so not re-reported here, but the station should note the hook's behavior (skill-invoke-gate.sh denies every tool call until Skill() is invoked, and that invocation is what injects the doctrine) is the enforcing half of that same defect, not just the SKILL.md prose.
